body.intent: When a run ends, whatever its outcome, nothing its steps wrote to the temporary folder is left behind: the daemon sets TMPDIR to the run's {run_tmp} for every process a run's steps start unless the workflow's [env] sets TMPDIR itself, so the agents and commands of a workflow whose [env] names no {run_tmp} write under {run_tmp}, which is already removed when the run ends; the /tmp/rhiza-projection-* leak stays bug 01M7M3JZFW's
